metric_definition.centered_logit_cosine: cosine after subtracting each vocabulary vector mean; this removes the unknown additive log-softmax constant and is directly comparable across HF, ThinTensor, and llama.cpp
metric_definition.q8_distribution: all vocabulary log-probabilities returned by llama.cpp n_probs=vocab_size
metric_definition.raw_logit_cosine: reported only when raw logits are available
